title: Microsoft Copilot mobile app: capture voice notes
summary: The briefing passes: its launch details match the roadmap, and Microsoft documentation supports the licensing, licence-assignment controls and general Copilot protections it describes. Independent searches found no documentation settling the voice-note-specific default, switch, recording storage or pricing gaps.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn feature page for this mobile voice-notes roadmap item was found at the time of writing.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how a note is recorded for this voice-notes feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile voice notes recording storage output retention sensitivity labels how record; "voice notes" "mobile" "Copilot" "recording". Opened release notes; read results for Sales agent and OneNote, which concern different features.

claims.claim: Beyond the roadmap description, Microsoft has not stated the specific output this feature produces.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile voice notes recording storage output retention sensitivity labels how record. Opened release notes and data protection and auditing; neither describes output for this item. OneNote and Sales output belongs to other features.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The licence-assignment path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. 2. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. 3. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. 4. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell assigns a user licence with Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.
